questions.stem: Identify the wrong match in relation to the type of atelectasis with its causative factor:
questions.solutionHtml:
Compression- Bronchiectasis

Compression atelectasis occurs when an external force compresses the lung, such as in the case of a pneumothorax (air in the pleural cavity) or a hemothorax (blood in the pleural cavity). It is not caused by Bronchiectasis.



Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 671
